200.description: Journal events after the supplied sequence cursor

SSE task.event carries TaskEvent JSON with the journal sequence as its id; task.done carries Task JSON. An idle stream sends a `: keepalive` comment every 15 seconds. While the task runs, task.text carries the visible reply text of the current model step ({step, text}, sent on connect and when a step starts) and task.delta appends to it. Live text has no event id, is not journaled and is not replayed; the completed task result is authoritative.

post.description: Pause a queued or running task. A queued task does not start; a running task waits at its next step boundary (before a model call, a tool call or settling) and journals paused. Its deadline keeps running. Idempotent.
Resume a paused task. Idempotent; resuming a task that is not paused changes nothing.

200.description: Current manifests of artifacts the task registered, oldest first
Newest current manifest registered for the digest

get.description: Artifact bytes as application/octet-stream, streamed and verified against the digest as they are sent (a mismatch ends the response before its last chunk). Use /content for the media type, ranges and digest headers.

Artifact transfer v2 content. Without Range (or with an If-Range that is not the ETag) the whole artifact is returned with 200 and verified as it streams; a single Range returns 206 with Content-Range, an unsatisfiable one 416. Every response carries Accept-Ranges: bytes, ETag "<sha256>", Repr-Digest (RFC 9530 sha-256), X-Content-SHA256, the manifest media type and Content-Disposition: attachment with the manifest name. A rendition has its own digest and is fetched the same way.

Every current form of an artifact, the original first (role original, purpose download). Given an original or any of its renditions, the list is the same. Select with HiveCommon selectRendition; download always means the original.
Newest current manifest for the digest as manifest 1.1 (a strict superset of 1.0 with optional rendition and provenance.execution).

post.description: Pull one artifact a configured A2A peer exported from one of its completed tasks, with transfer v2 (Range resume, SHA-256 verification) or, for an older peer, the v1 path up to 2 MiB. Idempotent per peer, task and artifact: a repeat returns the same import, and a failed import is queued again from its retained bytes. The import runs in the background and resumes after a restart.

get.description: Import progress. error.code is TRANSFER_REQUIRES_V2 (peer lacks urn:hive:artifact-transfer:2 and the artifact is over 2 MiB), DIGEST_MISMATCH (bytes discarded; reissue to retry), TRANSFER_TOO_LARGE, TRANSFER_SOURCE_GONE, TRANSFER_INTERRUPTED (retries exhausted; reissue resumes) or another stable code.

200.description: Active profile summary; capabilities.artifact_transfer is the highest artifact transfer version served

post.description: Re-read the management token named by api.token_env from the profile environment file the gateway started from and require it for every later request, without a restart. A token the service environment set cannot be rotated this way (409). The replaced token is still accepted for overlap_seconds (default 300, at most 3600; 0 ends it now), so a caller can switch over. Authenticate this request with the token in use. The token is never returned.

200.description: Credential reloaded; changed is false when the file holds the token already in use

previous_valid_until.description: Until when the replaced token is still accepted, or null

409.description: The service environment sets the token

422.description: Token missing, too short or malformed, or the environment file is unreadable; the token in use stays

post.description: Re-read the inbound and outbound tokens of every configured A2A peer from the profile environment file and use them without a restart (the peer list itself still needs a restart). A replaced inbound token is still accepted for overlap_seconds (default 300, at most 3600). The new set is validated as at startup; when it is not valid nothing changes. Tokens are never returned.

service_environment.description: Token variables the service environment sets; they are not read from the file

previous_valid_until.description: Until when the replaced inbound tokens are still accepted, or null

409.description: The A2A surface is not running

422.description: A peer credential is missing, too short, reused or not directional, or the environment file is unreadable; the credentials in use stay

post.description: Re-read the HiveMem agent credential named by memory.token_env from the profile environment file the gateway started from, and use it for every later HiveMem request without a restart. No other variable changes; requests in flight finish with the previous credential. The credential is never returned.

200.description: Credential reloaded; changed is false when the file holds the credential already in use

422.description: Credential missing, empty or malformed, or the environment file is unreadable; the previous credential stays in use
